import_provenance.original_title: Fast constant-factor fully dynamic edit distance
import_provenance.original_statement: Maintain a constant-factor approximation to edit distance between two strings under arbitrary single-character insertions, deletions and substitutions, using polylogarithmic expected amortized update time after polynomial preprocessing. The known joint work achieves subpolynomial approximation and update time, leaving this stronger combination open.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: This is an editorial strengthening of their tradeoff; exact algorithms whose update time depends on the current distance do not provide this guarantee for arbitrary strings.
